He was a sincere, grateful servant of Allah, fasting one day and not fasting the next, standing for half the night, sleeping a third and standing a sixth. He had a story with the hoopoe, which told him of a kingdom in Yemen whose people worshipped the sun instead of Allah. Solomon sent to the queen of Sheba requesting faith, but she sent him gifts. He asked the jinn to bring her throne; when she came and found her throne, she believed in Allah.
